title: Phantom Brigade
provenance: Reported by nickv2002 (highball-db#398, 2026-10-08), Apple M4 Pro, macOS 15.8.1, Highball 0.10.10, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r21, the environment in DXMT mode, rated 4 of 5 after 35 minutes. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported playable on DXMT, the default mode, over a 35-minute session. In full screen the reporter couldn't switch away to other apps, in windowed mode they could. No measurement here yet.

knownIssues.symptom: In full screen the game can't be hidden or switched away from to other apps
knownIssues.fix: Play in windowed mode, where switching works.
